product.olivetti-pcs46c.summary: 50 MHz i486DX2 PCS with ETEQ ET6000 and integrated Cirrus Logic GD5428 video.
product.olivetti-pcs46c.history: PCS 46/C uses board BA2036, based on the T.1 BA2044 assembly, with ET6000, 83C206Q, PC87310 and GD5428. M4-46 belongs to the related design family but is a distinct commercial model, not an alias.
product.olivetti-pcs46c.technical.rom_la: One 128 KB image: the lower half supplies OVC 1.09 at C0000h and the upper half supplies Resident Diagnostics/System BIOS 1.05 at F0000h.
product.olivetti-pcs46c.technical.verifi: POST, 4 MB detection, internal video, CMOS diagnostics, floppy/MS-DOS boot, a second NVR boot and Ctrl+Alt+Del have been observed.
product.olivetti-pcs46c.technical.limita: Bootable partial emulation: IDE, the other RAM populations and more software remain to be verified. Setup does not open from the keyboard; whether it runs from a utility disk remains to be established. The 83C206Q functions currently use the common AT core; this is neither a dedicated nor a cycle-exact model.
product.olivetti-pcs46c.technical.manual: Olivetti service guide chapter for M4-4x, M4-6x and PCS4xx (primary hardware source).
product.olivetti-pcs46c.creation.storage: No hard disk: one 1.44 MB floppy drive
product.olivetti-pcs46c.creation.model: PCS 46/C with an i486DX2/50, 4 MB, integrated GD5428 and one 1.44 MB floppy drive
product.olivetti-pcs46c.creation.note: If you add the disk, choose the type shown in the option in Setup.
product.olivetti-pcs46c.technical.cpu: Intel i486DX2/50 on the BA2036 board, derived from the T.1 BA2044 set. ETEQ ET6000 chipset with a separate 83C206Q for RTC, DMA, interrupts and timer.
product.olivetti-pcs46c.technical.memory: 4 to 36 MB (4, 8, 12, 20 or 36 MB), according to the service manual chapter for the M4-4x, M4-6x and PCS4xx.
product.olivetti-pcs46c.technical.video: Integrated Cirrus Logic CL-GD5428 VGA with 1 MB. Its video BIOS is OVC 1.09.
product.olivetti-pcs46c.technical.storag: Floppy, serial and parallel in the PC87310, and an IDE interface on the board. The BIOS disk table is the same as the M300-30 one, with types 17 to 26 for IDE disks.
product.olivetti-pcs46c.creation.cpu: Intel i486DX2-50: 50 MHz internally on a 25 MHz bus
